rows.label: bf02240100_0020
rows.name: Hmm... So you're the one from Iira.

rows.label: bf02240100_0030
rows.name:
The wanted poster's portrait
seems a little different.

rows.label: bf02240100_0040
rows.name:
It's completely different! Who drew me
looking that ugly?!

rows.label: bf02240100_0050
rows.name: Hah. Yes, I would be angry too.

rows.label: bf02240100_0070
rows.name:
You have no intention of
selling out your comrades?

rows.label: bf02240100_0090
rows.name:
If you call people who shoot at you
without care 'comrades', then yeah, sure.

rows.label: bf02240100_0100
rows.name:
I see. It seems things are complicated,
but that's not what interests me.

rows.label: bf02240100_0120
rows.name:
The Driver boy who was traveling
with you and his Blade-

rows.label: bf02240100_0130
rows.name: I want to know about them.
